newsitem.title: USA: Republic Industries to buy National Car-WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Republic Industries to buy National Car-WSJ.

text.p: Republic Industries Inc signed a definitive merger agreement to buy National Car Rental in a $600 million stock swap and assumption of $1.7 billion of vehicle debt, The Wall Street Journal reported Monday.
The move by Republic comes less than two months after it acquired Alamo Rent-A-Car, the story says.
The story said that together the fleets of Alamo and National will approach Hertz Corp's 250,000 domestic vehicles.
Republic's Chairman H. Wayne Huizenga has also begun a chain of used car superstores, AutoNation USA, and plans to supply them with cars from his rental companies, the Journal said.
Alamo and Nation will keep their brand names separate, the story said. The deal is to be announced by the companies Monday, the story said.
A Republic official was quoted as saying the transaction is expected to close in the first quarter and will be accretive to Republic's earnings.
